chronoseries.what_changes_at_this_horizon: No fossil chronospecies precedes or follows A. ehrenbergii in this 1/1 series. At 0 Ma the extant valve's silica-deposition vesicle crosses the Turing threshold: equal diffusion (the developmental predecessor, a homogeneous polyamine sol) has max Re sigma(k) < 0, while D_v/D_u = 31.18 (above the discriminant onset 13.605) selects lambda_c = 242 nm. The 100 um gallery scale bar is ~413 times coarser and is not this slot's wavelength.

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg 1979: du/dt = a - u + u^2 v + D_u laplacian(u); dv/dt = b - u^2 v + D_v laplacian(v)
equations.selected_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = 0.5 * (tr(k) + sqrt(tr(k)^2 - 4 det(k))), tr(k) = f_u + g_v - k^2 (D_u + D_v)
equations.boundary_conditions: Neumann (zero-flux) on a square patch of side L = 6 lambda_c, representing a closed silica-deposition vesicle with no flux of polyamine or silaffin across the silicalemma

parameters.provenance: a, b, ratio, arm count and pitch are slot-3118 modelling choices fixed so the analytic fastest mode equals the assigned 242 nm detail scale. They are not measurements quoted from a paper on A. ehrenbergii.

empirical_claims: Turing 1952: a homogeneous chemical steady state that is stable without diffusion can be unstable at a finite wavenumber when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster than the activator.

Sumper 2002 and Lenoci & Camp 2008: diatom biosilica nanopatterns are consistent with phase separation of polyamines inside the silica deposition vesicle, producing a characteristic nanometre-to-micrometre repeat.
Kröger, Deutzmann & Sumper 1999: silaffins (polycationic peptides embedded in the silica) nucleate silica nanospheres; they are the slow, matrix-bound species in this reconstruction.
Yendo & Akatsuka 1910: A. ehrenbergii was observed alive forming auxospores; the species is an extant Holocene diatom (0 Ma), which is the single horizon of this chronoseries.
This slot does not claim that any of those papers measured a 242 nm repeat specifically on A. ehrenbergii. 242 nm is the campaign detail-scale assignment.
